decisions.reason: After surviving its first years and fitting tightly with the firm's established psychiatric and therapeutic services, it is likely meeting or staying close enough to aspiration levels for management to continue it.

It remains mission-linked through workshop activity but is more peripheral and commercially exposed than core care services, so it stays the most droppable incumbent if results fall short, although current organisational slack still favors retention.
Its close fit with senior-care capabilities and its earlier strategic prominence suggest performance is likely satisfactory enough relative to aspirations to keep backing it.

As a newer and less established offering its results are still more uncertain, but because it complements the firm's senior-support services management is more likely to keep testing it than to withdraw it now.
